say:0:1660202001:2.text: As noon draws near, the morning chill gives way to a soft, golden warmth. Just outside Cedartown, a carriage sits among the trees—plain in shape, but crafted with exquisite care.
say:0:1660202001:2.source_cn: 临近午时，太阳驱散了晨起的寒风。雪松镇外，一辆样式简单...

say:2:1660202002:0.text: No driver sits at the reins. Instead, several silver bells shaped like blue sapphirine blossoms hang from the edge of the roof. The bells chime faintly in the wind, reminding you of a long-abandoned garden overgrown with everblooms.
say:2:1660202002:0.source_cn: 这辆车并没有马夫，车檐下悬挂着数朵蓝绒花样式的银铃铛。...
say:2:1660202002:0.male: No driver sits at the reins. Instead, several silver bells shaped like blue sapphirine blossoms hang from the edge of the roof. The bells chime faintly in the wind, reminding you of a long-abandoned garden overgrown with everblooms.
say:2:1660202002:0.female: No driver sits at the reins. Instead, several silver bells shaped like blue sapphirine blossoms hang from the edge of the roof. The bells chime faintly in the wind, reminding you of a long-abandoned garden overgrown with everblooms.

say:3:1660202003:1.text: The curtain lifts, and from within steps Ludovic. His skin is pale as moonlight, but his every movement is poised, deliberate.
say:3:1660202003:1.source_cn: 车帘掀起，面色苍白却举止优雅的柳博米尔从中走了出来。

say:5:1660202004:0.text: My friends. It's been quite some time.

say:6:1660202005:0.text: Ludovic! Wow, it's been so long! You, of all people, inviting someone to a show? Is this a prank?
say:6:1660202005:0.source_cn: 柳博米尔，好久不见！没想到你居然会邀请主人观看演出……

say:7:1660202006:1.text: And... shouldn't we be in town? You know... where the actual show is?
say:7:1660202006:1.source_cn: 呃，演出不应该是在雪松镇吗？为什么我们要在这里见面？

say:8:1660202007:0.text: Well, you know me. I'd sooner spend my time alone in the manor, surrounded by paintings and dusted memories. To me, artwork makes better company than applause.
say:8:1660202007:0.source_cn: 诸位应该知道，比起观看演出，我更愿意在庄园中独处，用艺...

say:9:1660202008:0.text: Still, it felt wrong to let this occasion pass without saying hello to you all. The show doesn't interest me, but your company does. Once the curtain falls, you're all welcome at Everstill Manor. That will be more than enough celebration for me.
say:9:1660202008:0.source_cn: 只是我与诸位分别已久，虽然我并不想观赏演出，但我依旧想...

say:10:1660202009:1.text: Hold on... you're not coming with us?
say:10:1660202009:1.source_cn: 欸，难道柳博米尔先生不和我们一起去看演出吗？

say:11:1660202010:1.text: Oh come on, Ludovic! Even a Graveborn needs a day out now and then! Look around, spring's at its best! You have to come!
say:11:1660202010:1.source_cn: 这怎么行！柳博米尔，就算是亡灵，也要偶尔出来晒晒太阳嘛...

say:12:1660202011:0.text: At your insistence, a faint smile crosses Ludovic's face—chilly, but warm enough by his standards. He gives a small nod.
say:12:1660202011:0.source_cn: 在你们的诚挚邀请下，柳博米尔脸上露出了一丝冷清但温柔的...
say:12:1660202011:0.male: At your insistence, a faint smile crosses Ludovic's face—chilly, but warm enough by his standards. He gives a small nod.
say:12:1660202011:0.female: At your insistence, a faint smile crosses Ludovic's face—chilly, but warm enough by his standards. He gives a small nod.

say:13:1660202012:0.text: Very well. Spring waits for no one, and neither should friends. Allow me to lead the way.
say:13:1660202012:0.source_cn: 春光与友谊不可辜负。既然如此，请允许我来带路吧。
